hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -q 'git commit' && echo "$CMD" | grep -q 'wms-api'; then cd ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-/home/nampark/dev/wms-claude}/v1/wms-api && mvn test -q 2>&1 || exit 2; fi
hooks.rewakeMessage: mvn test FAILED after wms-api commit — output:

hooks.command: changed=$(cd ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-/home/nampark/dev/wms-claude}/v1/wms-api && { git diff HEAD --name-only 2>/dev/null; git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null; git show --name-only --format='' HEAD 2>/dev/null; } | grep 'src/main/java.*service.*\.java' | sort -u | head -5); if [ -n "$changed" ]; then printf '{"systemMessage": "Java service files modified — consider running /verify-docs to check for doc drift."}'; fi
